promote_guide.what_sod_gives: T-0032 makes the grant-resolver SoD-aware on the approve/transition path. When the composition root wires a SodSource (deps.sod port — Postgres DAO in T-0053), any approve or transition op on an object covered by a sod_constraint is checked: (1) static SoD — does the performing principal hold two conflicting roles simultaneously within the constraint scope? (2) dynamic SoD — did the principal already submit/approve at a conflicting level on this specific object? On violation: { denied: true, reason: 'sod_violation' }, zero actor_event rows written. On pass: exactly one actor_event row appended, attribution by COALESCE(on_behalf_of, actor). The guard is additive and fail-open-by-absence: without deps.sod the entire step 3.6 is skipped (pre-T-0032 behavior).

honest_deferred.T-0053: Postgres SodSource/ActorEventReader/ActorEventWriter DAO — live queries against choros.sod_constraint and choros.actor_event. Until T-0053 lands, deps.sod is never injected by a production caller (in-memory implementations exist and are tested; the guard is reachable but not activated in production). Also owns FF-SOD8 atomicity obligation: SoD read + actor_event append over the SAME withTenant(pool,tenant,fn) PoolClient (one BEGIN..COMMIT) for TOCTOU safety.
honest_deferred.T-0022_confirmed_by_filter: AC-3 / R-2 T-0022: effectiveness filter (confirmed_by IS NOT NULL, in-validity-window, scope-overlap) is the DAO's responsibility. The in-memory SodSource used in tests accepts pre-filtered assignments; the Postgres DAO in T-0053 must apply the confirmed_by IS NOT NULL + window + scope filter when implementing effectiveAssignmentsOf.
honest_deferred.T-0068: Engine-side wiring of the guarded caller (deps.sod injection into resolveFor + guardCtx construction from the lifecycle engine context). T-0032 owns the gateway guard; T-0068 owns the caller that activates it in the running Flowable engine.

promote_guide.migration_027_summary: CREATE TABLE choros.sod_constraint (tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, id UUID NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('static','dynamic')), role_a UUID NULL, role_b UUID NULL, self_record BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false, scope JSONB NOT NULL, detail JSONB NULL, created_at BIGINT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id), CONSTRAINT sod_constraint_static_shape CHECK(kind <> 'static' OR (role_a IS NOT NULL AND role_b IS NOT NULL))). ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; isolation policy on choros.tenant_id GUC. GRANT SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE TO choros_app. sod_constraint added to ci/checks/known_tenant_tables.txt.
promote_guide.migration_028_summary: CREATE TRIGGER actor_event_seq_no_decrement BEFORE UPDATE FOR EACH ROW ON choros.actor_event_seq EXECUTE FUNCTION choros.prevent_seq_decrement(). Raises restrict_violation (23001) when NEW.next_seq < OLD.next_seq for all roles incl. owner and choros_migrator. Forward +1 advance under SELECT..FOR UPDATE passes. Closes FO-T0019-1 structurally at the DB layer.

forward_obligations.title: Postgres SodSource / ActorEventReader / ActorEventWriter DAO + FF-SOD8 atomicity
forward_obligations.why: Until T-0053 lands, SoD enforcement is NOT active on live transitions (deps.sod is never injected in production). T-0053 must: (1) implement SodSource.constraintsFor via SELECT on choros.sod_constraint; (2) implement SodSource.effectiveAssignmentsOf with confirmed_by IS NOT NULL + validity-window + scope-overlap filter (AC-3, R-2 T-0022); (3) implement ActorEventReader (trail/didPrincipalPerform/rolesThatActed) and ActorEventWriter (appendActorEvent) against choros.actor_event; (4) construct reader/writer/source over the SAME withTenant PoolClient so the SoD check and append are one atomic transaction (FF-SOD8, NF-8).
forward_obligations.fitness_obligation: FF-SOD8 atomicity must be enforced at the DAO layer (one BEGIN..COMMIT per guarded resolveFor call covering both the SoD read and the actor_event append).

forward_obligations.title: Engine-side wiring: deps.sod injection + guardCtx construction in Flowable lifecycle engine
forward_obligations.why: T-0032 owns the gateway guard (step 3.6/6.5 in resolveFor). T-0068 owns the caller: constructing GuardContext from the engine's execution context (actor, onBehalfOf, roleAtEvent, verb, approveLevel) and injecting deps.sod (the T-0053 DAO) into resolveFor on approve/transition events. Without T-0068, the SoD guard is reachable in tests but is never activated by the running engine.

forward_obligations.title: confirmed_by filter in effectiveAssignmentsOf (T-0053 DAO)
forward_obligations.why: AC-3 and R-2 from T-0022 spec require that effectiveAssignmentsOf (the SodSource port) returns only confirmed (confirmed_by IS NOT NULL), in-validity-window, scope-overlapping assignments. The in-memory SodSource used in T-0032 tests accepts pre-filtered inputs; the T-0053 Postgres DAO must apply the filter in its SELECT query.

known_issues.component: ci/checks/db — default parallel vitest forks on fresh Postgres
known_issues.description: ci/checks/db runs test files in parallel forks against ONE shared Postgres. On a FRESH DB the default-parallel npm run fitness:db can intermittently fail AC-4/FF-CT4 (cross_tenant.test.ts DELETE-count race seeded by a sibling file). T-0032's seedSodConstraint touches only sod_constraint, not application rows — cannot cause the race. Green 225/225 with --no-file-parallelism. Real CI (fresh per-run Postgres, default forks) CAN go intermittently red. Candidate fix (T-0062 or separate task): fileParallelism:false or per-file tenant-id namespacing for the db suite.
